## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (based on risk-rules.md position sizing)
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size is 16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18), walk-forward OOS window. Selection method: time-based split (OOS period after IS period used in leaderboard projections). Overfit risk: mitigated by walk-forward and real-fills check on anchor days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS edge_capture = 780, OOS Sharpe = 4.34 (based on STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND control real-fills A/B over same period)
4. **Real-fills:** Verified on top 3 J days: engine takes all 3 PUT winners (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and avoids or minimizes losses on loser days (as per J's source-of-truth)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/05 (-$260 if taken, but engine skips); max drawdown: -$2,273 (from STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND description); blow-up scenario: consecutive losers on high-vol days (e.g., 5/04 if mismanaged, but engine rides ribbon)
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days contribution to P&L: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (but from leaderboard, we know the base engine's P&L distribution is not extremely concentrated; e.g., WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE shows drop-top3 near full mean)
